description: Validate successful LTE attach procedure with a single UE under excellent radio conditions.
preconditions: Single cell LTE setup with no inter-cell interference.
Stationary UE placed under excellent LTE RSRP conditions as per Clause 4.6.
All other cells powered off.
testSteps: Configure the test setup according to the specified test configuration and record parameters.
Activate the serving LTE cell under test.
Place the UE under excellent radio conditions at cell center near eNB antenna.
Start logging to capture call flow and signaling messages.
Power ON the UE to initiate LTE attach procedure.
Wait for attach complete indication confirming UE is attached to the correct LTE cell (verify PCI, Global eNB ID, ARFCN).
Stop logging and save captured data.
expectedResults: Attach request and attach complete messages are successfully exchanged.
UE is attached to the correct LTE cell as per test configuration.
Attach success rate for this iteration is 100%.
postconditions: UE remains attached until detach test.
Logs are preserved for KPI analysis.
verificationMethods: Analyze UE logs or UE application to verify attach success and cell identity.
Examine signaling logs for attach request and complete messages.

description: Validate successful LTE detach procedure initiated by UE under excellent radio conditions.
preconditions: UE is successfully attached to LTE cell from previous test.
Test setup as per TC_POS_001.
testSteps: Start logging to capture call flow and signaling messages.
Power OFF the UE to initiate UE-initiated detach procedure.
Wait for detach accept and confirmation of UE context release in signaling.
Stop logging and save captured data.
expectedResults: Detach request and detach accept messages are successfully exchanged.
Signaling connection release is validated from message flow (UE context release and RRC connection release).
Detach success rate for this iteration is 100%.
postconditions: UE is detached from LTE cell.
Logs are preserved for KPI analysis.
verificationMethods: Analyze signaling logs for detach request and accept messages.
Verify release of UE context and RRC connection.

description: Validate successful 5G NSA attach procedure with Secondary Node Addition for single UE under excellent radio conditions.
preconditions: Single cell 5G NSA setup with no inter-cell interference.
Stationary UE placed under excellent 5G SS-RSRP conditions as per Clause 4.6.
All other cells powered off.
testSteps: Configure the test setup according to the specified test configuration and record parameters.
Activate the serving 5G NSA cell under test.
Place the UE under excellent radio conditions at cell center near eNB/gNB antennas.
Start logging to capture call flow and signaling messages.
Power ON the UE to initiate 5G NSA attach procedure.
Wait for attach complete indication with successful Secondary Node Addition (validate SgNB addition request and SgNB reconfiguration complete).
Stop logging and save captured data.
expectedResults: Attach request and attach complete messages are successfully exchanged.
Secondary Node Addition procedure completes successfully.
UE is attached to the correct LTE and 5G cells as per configuration (verify PCI, Global eNB ID/Global gNB ID, ARFCN/NR-ARFCN).
Attach success rate and Secondary Node Addition success rate are 100% for this iteration.
postconditions: UE remains attached until detach test.
Logs are preserved for KPI analysis.
verificationMethods: Analyze UE logs or applications to verify attach success and correct cell identities.
Examine signaling logs for attach and Secondary Node Addition messages.

description: Validate successful 5G NSA detach procedure including Secondary Node Release initiated by UE under excellent radio conditions.
preconditions: UE is successfully attached to 5G NSA cell with Secondary Node from previous test.
Test setup as per TC_POS_003.
testSteps: Start logging to capture call flow and signaling messages.
Power OFF the UE to initiate UE-initiated detach procedure.
Wait for detach accept and confirmation of UE context release in signaling.
Validate successful Secondary Node Release as per 3GPP TS 37.340 Clause 10.4.1 including SgNB Release Request and Acknowledge messages.
Stop logging and save captured data.
expectedResults: Detach request and detach accept messages are successfully exchanged.
Secondary Node Release procedure completes successfully.
Signaling connection release validated from message flow (UE context release and RRC connection release).
Detach success rate is 100% for this iteration.
postconditions: UE is detached from 5G NSA cell.
Logs are preserved for KPI analysis.
verificationMethods: Analyze signaling logs for detach and Secondary Node Release messages.
Verify release of UE context, RRC connection, and Secondary Node resources.

description: Validate attach-detach procedure for 10 consecutive iterations to ensure 100% success rate under excellent radio conditions.
preconditions: Test setup as per previous attach/detach test cases.
UE placed under excellent radio conditions.
testSteps: For iteration 1 to 10:
Start logging to capture call flow and signaling.
Power ON the UE to attach to LTE or 5G NSA cell.
Wait for successful attach and validate attach success.
Power OFF the UE to initiate detach.
Wait for successful detach and validate detach success.
Stop logging and save logs per iteration.
expectedResults: Attach and detach success rates are 100% across all 10 iterations.
Attach latency values (min, average, max) are within expected targets as per Table 5-3.
No failures or unexpected behavior observed.
postconditions: All logs and KPI measurements are recorded for analysis and gap reporting.
verificationMethods: Review logs for each iteration to confirm success of attach and detach procedures.
Calculate attach latency metrics from logs.
Compare KPIs against expected targets.

description: Verify system behavior when UE is placed under poor radio conditions below minimum coupling loss during attach.
preconditions: Single cell LTE or 5G NSA setup.
UE placed deliberately under poor radio conditions exceeding minimum coupling loss as defined in Clause 4.6.
testSteps: Configure test setup and record parameters.
Activate serving cell under test.
Place UE under poor radio conditions.
Start logging.
Power ON the UE to initiate attach procedure.
Wait and observe attach failure or timeout.
Stop logging and save logs.
expectedResults: Attach procedure fails or times out due to insufficient radio conditions.
Attach success rate is less than 100%.
Logs show attach request but no attach complete.
System handles failure gracefully without crash.
postconditions: UE remains detached.
Logs preserved for failure analysis.
verificationMethods: Analyze signaling logs for absence of attach complete message.
Monitor UE behavior for retry or failure handling.
Check system logs for error or timeout indications.

description: Validate system behavior when signaling messages are lost or delayed during UE-initiated detach.
preconditions: UE attached to LTE or 5G NSA cell.
Test environment simulates signaling message loss or delay.
testSteps: Start logging.
Power OFF the UE to initiate detach.
Simulate loss or delay of detach accept or UE context release messages.
Observe system response and timeouts.
Stop logging and save data.
expectedResults: Detach procedure fails or times out.
System retries or recovers gracefully without resource leaks.
Detach success rate decreased in logs.
UE eventually detaches or remains attached with proper timeout.
postconditions: System resources remain consistent without leakage.
Logs preserved for root cause analysis.
verificationMethods: Analyze signaling logs for missing or delayed messages.
Check system for retransmission attempts or error handling.
Verify UE state consistency post failure.

description: Measure attach latency over 10 iterations and analyze minimum, average, and maximum latency values under excellent radio conditions.
preconditions: Test setup as per positive attach tests.
UE under excellent radio conditions.
testSteps: Perform 10 attach cycles with corresponding detach as per TC_POS_005.
For each attach, measure time from attach request to attach complete.
Record latency values per iteration.
Sort latency values ascendingly and calculate min, average, max.
Save latency metrics in test report.
expectedResults: Attach latency metrics fall within expected ranges defined in Table 5-3.
No outliers indicating performance degradation.
postconditions: Latency data available for KPI comparison and gap analysis.
verificationMethods: Use timestamps from signaling logs to calculate attach latency.
Statistical analysis of latency values.
Compare with target KPIs.

description: Test attach-detach procedure stability and success rate when performed repeatedly under load conditions (e.g., multiple consecutive attach-detach cycles).
preconditions: Single UE test setup.
Test environment simulates continuous operation over extended period.
testSteps: Repeat attach-detach procedure for more than 10 iterations (e.g., 50 or 100).
Monitor attach and detach success rates and latency.
Observe system resource usage and stability.
Log all signaling and performance metrics.
expectedResults: Attach and detach success rates remain high (near 100%).
No degradation or resource exhaustion over iterations.
Attach latency remains stable without significant increase.
System remains stable without crashes or failures.
postconditions: All logs and metrics saved for performance analysis.
verificationMethods: Analyze success rates and latency trends over time.
Monitor system logs and resource utilization.
Detect any memory leaks or crashes.

description: Validate that the attach procedure enforces proper authentication and authorization mechanisms as per 3GPP standards.
preconditions: Test setup with network configured for normal authentication.
UE supports required security protocols.
testSteps: Power ON the UE to initiate attach.
Capture signaling messages related to authentication (e.g., Authentication Request / Response).
Attempt attach with invalid credentials or altered authentication vectors (if feasible).
Observe network response to failed authentication.
expectedResults: Attach procedure succeeds only with valid authentication.
Attach fails with invalid authentication with appropriate error messages.
No unauthorized access allowed.
Security messages are encrypted and integrity protected.
postconditions: System maintains secure state after attach attempts.
verificationMethods: Analyze signaling logs for authentication flows.
Verify encryption and integrity protection presence.
Check for correct failure handling on bad credentials.

description: Validate coexistence and interaction of LTE and 5G NSA attach-detach procedures in a single UE scenario.
preconditions: Test setup with both LTE and 5G NSA cells configured.
UE supports dual connectivity with LTE and 5G NSA.
testSteps: Configure UE to attach to LTE and subsequently add 5G Secondary Node (EN-DC).
Perform attach and Secondary Node Addition.
Perform detach including Secondary Node Release.
Verify signaling flows across LTE and 5G components.
Repeat procedure multiple times.
expectedResults: Seamless attach and detach with coordinated LTE and 5G NSA signaling.
Secondary Node Addition and Release succeed as per specifications.
No signaling conflicts or errors.
KPIs meet expected thresholds.
postconditions: UE and network return to idle state after detach.
verificationMethods: Analyze full signaling traces for LTE and 5G NSA combined flows.
Verify correct handover of UE context and resources.
Check KPI metrics for both RATs.

description: Verify that the test procedure for attach-detach is clear, easy to follow, and repeatable by test engineers.
preconditions: Test documentation and procedure steps are available.
Test engineers with baseline knowledge.
testSteps: Provide test engineers with procedure steps.
Observe their ability to setup test environment and execute 10 attach-detach iterations.
Collect feedback on clarity, ambiguities, and difficulties.
Assess time taken and error rates.
expectedResults: Test engineers complete procedures without confusion or errors.
Test steps are logically ordered and sufficiently detailed.
Minimal need for clarification or additional support.
Test repeatability is high.
postconditions: Feedback collected and documented for procedure improvement.
verificationMethods: Survey and interview test engineers.
Review test logs and reports for completeness.
Assess adherence to procedure steps.

description: Verify the attach-detach test procedure works correctly with both real UEs and UE emulators under excellent radio conditions.
preconditions: Test setup capable of using either real UE or UE emulator.
Test configuration documented.
testSteps: Configure test environment with real UE and perform 10 attach-detach iterations.
Record KPIs and logs.
Repeat the same test with UE emulator.
Compare results and behavior between real UE and emulator.
expectedResults: Attach and detach procedures complete successfully with both real UE and emulator.
KPIs are comparable within acceptable tolerance.
No functional discrepancies observed.
Test procedure is compatible with both UE types.
postconditions: Logs and KPI records preserved for comparison.
verificationMethods: Analyze logs and KPIs from both UE types.
Compare attach/detach success rates and latency.
Check for any emulator-specific anomalies.

description: Test behavior when Secondary Node Release request is rejected by the Secondary Node (SN) during 5G NSA detach.
preconditions: UE attached to 5G NSA cell with active Secondary Node.
SN configured to reject SgNB Release Request (e.g., due to ongoing SN change procedure).
testSteps: Initiate UE-initiated detach procedure causing MN to send SgNB Release Request to SN.
SN rejects release request by not sending acknowledge or sending rejection message.
Observe signaling and system behavior.
Verify handling of rejection by MN and UE.
expectedResults: MN properly handles rejection of SN release request.
System either retries release or follows fallback procedure without crash.
UE context release and RRC connection release are eventually completed or proper error handling occurs.
No resource leaks or inconsistent states.
postconditions: System returns to stable state after rejection handling.
verificationMethods: Analyze signaling logs for SgNB Release Request and rejection.
Verify MN retry or alternative handling.
Check UE state and resource release.

description: Validate the cancellation of Conditional PSCell Activation (CPA) and inter-SN Conditional PSCell Change (CPC) during Secondary Node Release procedure.
preconditions: UE attached to 5G NSA cell with CPA or inter-SN CPC configured.
Candidate SNs and PSCells prepared.
testSteps: Trigger Secondary Node Release initiated by MN or SN.
Observe cancellation of all prepared PSCells at candidate SN.
Verify MN cancels all CPAC configurations in candidate SNs.
Check that MN triggers Conditional PSCell Change Cancel towards source SN if SN initiated.
Validate signaling flows and message sequences for cancellation.
expectedResults: All prepared PSCells at candidate SNs are cancelled successfully.
CPAC configurations are removed appropriately.
Conditional PSCell Change Cancel procedure is triggered when applicable.
No residual configurations or inconsistent states remain.
Signaling flows comply with 3GPP TS 37.340 Clause 10.4.1.
postconditions: UE context and radio resources related to canceled PSCells are released.
System remains stable.
verificationMethods: Analyze signaling messages for cancellation requests and acknowledgments.
Check configuration state in network elements.
Verify UE reconfiguration messages.

description: Evaluate system behavior when UE is placed exactly at the minimum coupling loss limit defined in Clause 4.6.
preconditions: Test setup capable of adjusting RF attenuation precisely.
Minimum coupling loss defined and known.
testSteps: Adjust RF attenuation to achieve exactly minimum coupling loss.
Place UE under these conditions.
Perform attach and detach procedures for 10 iterations.
Record success rates, latency, and radio parameters (RSRP, RSRQ).
expectedResults: Attach and detach procedures succeed reliably at minimum coupling loss.
Radio parameters are within acceptable ranges.
No borderline failures or unexpected behavior.
KPIs meet expected targets.
postconditions: Logs and KPI data preserved for analysis.
verificationMethods: Measure and verify RF attenuation and coupling loss.
Analyze attach/detach success and latency.
Check radio parameter logs.
